metadata.case_name: LAI CHI PON v. TOTO STEEL & IRON WORKS LTD AND OTHERS

injuries.description: compressed fracture of his vertebra at T11 and T12
source: He was found to have a compressed fracture of his vertebra at T11 and T12.
The Plaintiff is now an incomplete paraplegic.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of spinal cord at abdomen, lower back or pelvis level, unspecified

source: He has an unstable neurogenic bladder which empties poorly.
He is suffering from Adjustment Disorder.

manifestations.description: Limited movement of his lower limbs: unable to stand without support; can only walk with crutches and an ankle-foot orthosis; can only walk awkwardly and clumsily; cannot run or move or turn quickly; not able to walk on slopes and great difficulties climbing stairs; cannot carry anything heavy when using crutches other than a small light bag; unable to sit for more than an hour without unbearable pain in his back; crutches have caused blisters on his palms; ankle-foot orthosis has caused blisters on his feet.

Reduced sensation from his abdomen downwards: generally no sensation below the knee; limited sensation in thighs; constant pain, discomfort and paraesthesia in both legs above the knees interfering with daily activities; unable to feel temperatures; spasms in both legs when sleeping or sitting occurring about 2-3 times per week, lasting about 15 minutes.

Double incontinence: partial bladder sensation with reflex emptying and tendency to retention; empties bladder by straining and tapping on the abdomen; wets himself twice a week and needs to wear diapers at night; requires going to toilet about 30 minutes after drinking; moves bowel every 2 to 3 days and requires suppositories; still occasionally incontinent.

Sexual dysfunction: sexual ability greatly impaired; fails 70% of attempts to have sexual intercourse with his wife; has not had sexual intercourse with his wife for over 1½ years; has lost much if not all of his sexual drive and feels very embarrassed; sexual dysfunction is psychological in nature.
Psychiatric symptoms: depressed mood; low self-esteem; lack of interest in most activities; pessimistic feelings; feelings of inability to cope.
Need for regular medical supervision: prone to future complications such as pressure sores and urinary tract infection; requires regular check-up and supervision of renal and urinary status.
Inability to sit for more than an hour without unbearable back pain.

source: Twenty-four days after the accident, operation was performed on his spine.
He was hospitalised for 27 months, thereafter he received follow-up treatment from a private doctor and from the MacLehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre.

treatments_received.treatment: Follow-up treatment from a private doctor and from the MacLehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre
source: thereafter he received follow-up treatment from a private doctor and from the MacLehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre.

treatments_future.treatment: Individual psychotherapy (ten sessions once every two weeks) and sex therapy (ten sessions)
source: The cost of the psychiatric treatment is $50,000 which consists of psychotherapy once every two weeks for ten sessions and sex therapy for ten sessions.

treatments_future.treatment: Occupational therapy (detailed schedule: three times a week for first six months at $800 per session, thereafter once a week for next six months, once every two weeks for next six months; after 18 months once a month plus four extra sessions a year)
source: It is recommended by Ms Alice Tsang, occupational therapist, that the therapy would be three times a week for the first six months at $800 per session, thereafter once a week for the next six months and once every two weeks for the next six months. After the 18 months treatment, the therapy will take place once a month plus four extra sessions a year.

treatments_future.treatment: Physiotherapy (three times a week for first six months at $400 per session, thereafter schedules as occupational therapy)
source: The cost of the treatment is three times a week for the first six months at $400 per session at $31,200, thereafter once a week for the next six months at $10,400 and thereafter once every two weeks for the next six months at $5,200. After the 18 months treatment, the therapy will take place once a month plus four extra sessions a year.

treatments_future.treatment: Regular medical treatment and annual check-up (private) and supervision of renal and urinary status
source: Costs for medical treatment once every three months is at $600 per visit : $2,400 x 15 = $36,000. There should be annual check-up and treatment in case of complication at $4,000 per treatment. Costs is $4,000 x 15 = $60,000.
He therefore needs regular check-up and supervision, especially as to his renal and urinary status.

treatments_future.treatment: Nursing care (30 sessions per year at $390 per hour) with multiplier 7.5
source: According to Ms Tsang, the cost of the nursing fee of $390 per hour and 30 sessions per year are required.

treatments_future.treatment: Full-time domestic helper (Filipino) including agency handling, salary, relief staff, travel, insurance and renewals (detailed costs)
source: Full-time Filipino domestic helper
Initial handling cost by agency at $4,000 per contract 4,000
Basic monthly salary at $3,860 per month 46,320 x 15 = 694,800
Relief staff for home leave at $2,100 per year, based on 1 home leave of 2 weeks per 2 years, relief staff for 7 days @$300/full day 2,100 x 15 = 31,500
Traveling fee for home leave, based on 1 home leave per 2 years, @$1,500 750 x 15 = 11,250
Misc. costs incl. Insurance, renewal of contract & immigration, etc at about $3,500 per annum 3,500 x 15 = 52,500

treatments_future.treatment: Provision of lightweight manual wheelchair and accessories (replacement and maintenance schedule)
source: Lightweight wheelchair with replacement every 6 years $13,500 x 2.5 = $33,750
Maintenance of wheelchair at 30% of costs $4,050 x 2.5 = $10,125
Anti-decubitus cushion with replacement every 3 years $3,500 x 5 = $17,500
Wheelchair lap board every 2 years $500 x 7.5 = $3,750
Wheelchair mitt with replacement every 1 year $300 x 15 = $4,500

losses.description: Limited movement of his lower limbs: unable to stand without support; can only walk with crutches and an ankle-foot orthosis; cannot run or move or turn quickly; not able to walk on slopes and great difficulties climbing stairs; unable to sit for more than an hour.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Sexual ability greatly impaired; fails 70% of attempts to have sexual intercourse; has lost much if not all of his sexual drive and feels very embarrassed.
Requires full-time helper; cannot carry heavy items when using crutches; needs assistance for household chores and accompaniment when going out.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Needs a full-time helper to help the wife with ordinary household chores and to accompany the Plaintiff when he goes out.
Restricted mobility and need for attendant when going out; requires allowance for socialisation activities and accompaniment.
Double incontinence, reduced sensation from abdomen downwards and other bodily impairments affecting normal bodily functions.
